strain: C57BL/6J (WT and β-arrestin2 KO on C57BL/6J background)

sex.evidence: experimental cohorts comprised male and female WT and KO littermates

dosing.evidence: Psilocin ... dissolved in 50 mM tartaric acid, then pH was increased to 5.5 ... before diluting further in 5% glucose-saline and 0.9% saline ... All drugs were injected i.p. at a volume of 10 mL/kg.
DOI hydrochloride (Cambridge Bioscience) and LSD (Chiron) were dissolved in 0.9% saline ... All drugs were injected i.p. at a volume of 10 mL/kg.
Both WT and β-arrestin2 KO mice displayed head-twitches in response to 0.3 mg/kg LSD ... dissolved in 0.9% saline ... injected i.p.

handling.evidence: No handling protocol described; only room/cage habituation for 90 min before injection is mentioned.

group_housing.evidence: All mice were group housed (4-6 per cage, 21 °C, 12 h light-dark cycle)

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12 h light-dark cycle stated, but direction/lights-on time and testing phase not specified.

enrichment_housing.evidence: individually ventilated cages lined with sawdust bedding and cage enrichment

assays.assay_description: Mice placed individually in clear cages immediately after i.p. injection and video-recorded for 20 min; head-twitches counted offline by a blinded observer, analysed as 20-min totals and time-course. Includes psilocin dose-response (1, 2, 5 mg/kg), MDL-100,907 (0.3 mg/kg) antagonism, and WT vs β-arrestin2 KO comparisons with psilocin (1 mg/kg), DOI (2 mg/kg) and LSD (0.3 mg/kg).

application_type.evidence: All drugs were injected i.p. at a volume of 10 mL/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: On the day of experiment, mice were habituated to the experimental room and their individual cages for 90 min before the first injection.

setup_restrain.evidence: Immediately after injection, mice were placed individually in clear cages and recorded by video for 20 min.

food_restriction.evidence: Test conducted in clear cages for 20 min; no food in test cage described (standard short test).

water_restriction.evidence: Test conducted in clear cages for 20 min; no water in test cage described (standard short test).

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately after injection, mice were placed individually in clear cages and recorded by video for 20 min.

sample_size.evidence: Figure 1A (n = 14-16); Figure 1B (n = 13-14); Figure 3 (vehicle n = 6-11, DOI n = 8-11, LSD n = 12-14)

outcomes.summary: Psilocin (1, 2, 5 mg/kg) increased head-twitches vs vehicle at all doses with an inverted U-shaped dose-response; 1 mg/kg psilocin HTR was abolished by MDL-100,907. Psilocin, DOI and LSD increased head-twitches equally in WT and β-arrestin2 KO mice, with no genotype effect on totals or time-course; no consistent sex difference.
outcomes.evidence: psilocin administration (1, 2, or 5 mg/kg i.p.) significantly increased the number of head-twitches compared to vehicle at all doses (F3,56.033 = 51.634, p < 0.0001; Figure 1A), albeit with an inverted U-shaped dose-response ... The head-twitch response to psilocin was not different between wildtype and β-arrestin2 knockout (KO) mice, and the head-twitch responses to DOI and LSD were similarly unaffected by β-arrestin2 KO.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Head-twitch counts were made by direct observation postexperiment by an experimenter blind to treatment and genotype.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: left, head-twitches accumulated over 20 min; right, timecourse over 20 min

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No sequence, transition or bout-structure analysis described.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only head-twitch response measured (HTR excluded as ethological by rubric).

B5_social.evidence: mice were placed individually in clear cages

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR is a drug-induced unlearned response; no learning component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Head-twitch counts were made by direct observation postexperiment

B8_multivariate.evidence: Data were analyzed using a mixed effect model and type III ANOVA; no multivariate behavioural analysis.

E1_environment_type.evidence: mice were placed individually in clear cages

E7_social_context.evidence: mice were placed individually in clear cages

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in test cages described.

D1_continuity.evidence: Immediately after injection, mice were placed individually in clear cages and recorded by video for 20 min.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single 20-min session per mouse on the day of experiment.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug HTR recording described; recording began immediately after injection.

D5_followup.evidence: No recording ≥24 h after dosing described.

judge_notes: Single behavioural assay (HTR); psilocin dose-response, MDL-100,907 antagonism, and WT vs β-arrestin2 KO arms with psilocin, DOI and LSD all collapsed into one assay per rubric.
qPCR gene expression and primary neuron dendritogenesis (Sholl analysis) excluded as non-behavioural.
B1 set to score 0 (one measure: head-twitch count); gemma's score of 1 for value '1' was inconsistent with rubric.
D2 set to score 1 (20 min falls in 15–60 min); gemma's '<15 min' was an error.
day_night_flipped set to not_reported (modal): only '12 h light-dark cycle' stated without direction.
setup_habituation set to 'yes' (modal, medium confidence): mice habituated to 'their individual cages' for 90 min before injection, though whether these are the clear test cages is ambiguous.
n_total left null: candidate sums (160, 110) were not derivable from reported ranges; n_per_group_min = 6 from Figure 3 vehicle group.
